title: LightPack
description: Making Minecraft hard but not hard enough.
body:
# Purpose of the modpack

This modpack is about **giving you challanges**, no more just hunger but also **thirst**!
Find a way to survive in this unforgiving world with many mechanics! Making **Minecraft more grindy** than before but also keeping it not too hard and not too easy, making it a simple challange while adding certian stuff to Minecraft. Go ahead and explore the world and it's wonderful existence.

## What it adds

- Thirst
- Harder crafting
- Thirst system
- Temperature
- New items to Minecraft

Much more is gonna be added.
